info.title: axeos-dashboard API

get.description: Every user-triggered action that matters (miner restart, pool switch, config save, audit export, backups download, network scan) between from (inclusive) and to (exclusive) -- newest first. Both default to the last 24 hours; the range can't exceed a year. API entries carry the client's IP and User-Agent, system entries the service that acted (e.g. the scheduler).

parameters.description: only this miner's entries (its IP) -- a pool switch applied to every miner included
parameters.name: ip

parameters.description: only this type -- one of GET /api/audit/types
parameters.name: type

400.description: from/to malformed, from not before to, or range over a year

500.description: the audit log couldn't be read

get.description: Same range and defaults as GET /api/audit (last 24 hours, at most a year), unpaginated, as a JSON file attachment: the resolved range, the export time and the entry count, then every entry.

parameters.description: only this miner's entries (its IP) -- a pool switch applied to every miner included
parameters.name: ip

parameters.description: only this type -- one of GET /api/audit/types
parameters.name: type

400.description: from/to malformed, from not before to, or range over a year

500.description: the audit log couldn't be read

get.description: Every type an audit entry can have, in the order the dashboard offers them -- the values GET /api/audit and /api/audit/export accept as type.
Returns the monthly backup archives, most recent first. The feeder adds each completed (UTC) day to its month's archive, so the current month's archive is complete up to yesterday.
Returns one zip holding the given months' archives (up to yesterday for the current month): every miner's daily JSONL files under data/bitaxes/ -- unzip into storage.dataDir to restore.

404.description: no backup for one of the months

get.description: Probes a single IP (?ip=) or sweeps a CIDR range (?cidr=, max /24, defaults to the server's own local /24 subnet when both are omitted). ip takes priority if both are set.
get.summary: Discover AxeOS devices on the network

parameters.description: Probe exactly this one IP instead of scanning a range (e.g. a device on a different VLAN than the server). Takes priority over cidr.
parameters.name: ip

parameters.description: Network range to sweep, e.g. '192.168.1.0/24' (max /24 = 254 hosts). Omitted: auto-detects and scans the server's own local /24 subnet. Ignored if ip is set.
parameters.name: cidr

parameters.description: Per-host probe timeout, e.g. '500ms' or '2s' (default 1s, capped at 3s). Raise it and retry if a scan/probe found nothing on a slow network.
parameters.name: timeout

404.description: no AxeOS device found at the given ip

post.description: Has the mailer service send a test mail to every configured recipient through the saved SMTP server.

parameters.description: Mail language (fr or en, default en)
parameters.name: request

400.description: SMTP server or recipients not configured

502.description: the SMTP server refused or couldn't be reached

get.description: Returns every miner entry in the managed miners config, including disabled ones. Read-only -- see POST/DELETE for writing.

post.description: Upserts one or more miner entries into the managed miners file, matched by MAC. New entries are always saved enabled.

200.description: the full, updated list of configured miners

409.description: server not started with -miners -- nowhere safe to write

500.description: failed to write the miners file

get.description: Returns the settings.yml overrides, the built-in defaults for pool dashboards/firmware repos, and a read-only snapshot of process-launch settings (poll intervals, firmware cache TTL) shown for visibility only.

post.description: Validates and persists the editable subset of app settings to settings.yml.

409.description: server has no resolvable config path -- nowhere safe to write

500.description: failed to write the app-settings file

get.description: Returns this binary's git SHA, whether it's up to date with the latest GitHub release, the UI feature flags (see config.UIConfig), whether this is remote-dashboard-api (as opposed to dashboard-api), and (remote-dashboard-api only) the hashboard base URL.

The mailer's own API, on the loopback only (mailer.port, default 8082): since when it runs, and when its loop last looked for a mail to send (once a minute). Read through dashboard-api's GET /api/status.

post.description: The mailer's own API, on the loopback only (mailer.port, default 8082): sends a test mail to every recipient through the saved SMTP server. Reached through dashboard-api's POST /api/config/mail/test.

parameters.description: Mail language (fr or en, default en)
parameters.name: request

400.description: SMTP server or recipients not configured

502.description: the SMTP server refused or couldn't be reached

get.description: Returns every enabled miner with its latest snapshot (hashrate, temp, shares, pool, uptime...).

An alert is raised once when it starts and cleared once when it ends -- each is one event. Returns the most recent ones (last 30 days), across every miner, most recent first, and up to when they've been read.
get.summary: List the most recent alert changes

get.description: Every alert raised and not cleared yet on an enabled miner, however long ago it was raised -- the event that raised it, most recent first.
Every alert raised or cleared on the given UTC day, across every miner, most recent first, optionally filtered by ip/type.
get.summary: List a single day's alert changes, paginated

parameters.description: filter to this miner IP only
parameters.name: ip

parameters.description: filter to this alert type only
parameters.name: type

post.description: Marks every alert up to seenAt as read, for every browser -- never moves it back. Returns the resulting seenAt.

get.description: Hashrate of every configured miner over the last 24 hours, averaged into 15-minute buckets (96 points, oldest first). Feeds the dashboard's fleet chart and per-miner sparklines.
get.summary: Get the last 24h of every miner, downsampled

put.description: Switches miner(s) to the primary or fallback pool and restarts them to apply it.

parameters.description: Miner IP or hostname — omit to apply to all configured miners
parameters.name: miner

502.description: one or more miners didn't apply the change (unreachable, or rejected the request)

put.description: Switches miner(s) to the primary or fallback pool and restarts them to apply it.

parameters.description: Miner IP or hostname — omit to apply to all configured miners
parameters.name: miner

502.description: one or more miners didn't apply the change (unreachable, or rejected the request)

post.description: Restarts the device via its AxeOs restart endpoint.

502.description: the miner is unreachable or rejected the restart request

get.description: Returns every JSONL entry (one per poll cycle) of the last 24 hours for a single miner, oldest first, used by the miner panel's history chart. An empty array when nothing was recorded in that time.
get.summary: Get the last 24h of stats for one miner

get.description: Returns what hashboard knows about the board this instance pushes to: the link to its remote dashboard, and when hashboard last received a sample for it. Empty when remote push isn't configured, or hashboard can't be reached. Cached for one feeder interval.

How each process is doing -- dashboard-api, the feeder (its last poll), the health check, the mailer, the firmware cache: ok, late (nothing within twice its interval), offline (didn't answer) or unknown (no run yet). Also whether remote (hashboard) push is configured.
Auto-discovers miners from the board's bitaxes directory — no local config needed, data comes from whatever the feeder already pushed to hashboard.live.
get.summary: List miners pushed to a hashboard board (read-only)

get.description: Same as /api/miners/history, for the miners pushed to a hashboard board.
get.summary: Get the last 24h of every remote miner, downsampled (read-only)

get.description: Same as /api/miners/{hostnameOrIp}/stats, for a miner pushed to a hashboard board.
get.summary: Get the last 24h of stats for one remote miner (read-only)

raisedAt.description:
Cleared only: when it was raised, and the highest reading meanwhile
(temp/fan).

value.description:
Raised only: the reading that raised it (temp/fan), or what it's about
(the firmware available, the MAC reported, the connection error).

changes.description:
What changed, before and after -- for the security-relevant types
(see changes.go).

error.description: Why it failed, whatever its source.

ip.description:
API only: there's no authentication, so the client's IP and
User-Agent are the closest thing to "who" this tool can record.

query.description:
The request's query string, unescaped -- what was asked for (the
months downloaded, the exported range, the miner a pool switch
targeted...).

target.description:
Target is the IP of the miner acted on -- empty for a config save,
or a pool switch applied to every miner.

checksum.description: Checksum is the archive's MD5, set once the month is final.

skipIfEmpty.description: SkipIfEmpty sends nothing for a period nothing was recorded in.

types.description: Types narrows it to these audit entry types -- all of them when empty.

alias.description:
Alias is an optional operator-set override for the display name shown
in the UI wherever Hostname would otherwise be shown (see
DisplayName). Unlike Hostname -- which a network discovery re-probe
(see internal/discovery, and the "select an already-configured
device" refresh flow in the Settings UI) silently overwrites with
whatever the device itself reports -- Alias is never touched by
discovery, so it's the one place a custom, human-chosen name survives
a refresh.

mac.description:
Mac is the device's MAC address (colons/hyphens optional, normalized
by StorageKey) -- the storage-directory key, stable across IP/
location changes unlike Ip. Populated either by hand or by the network
discovery flow (see internal/discovery), which reads it straight off
the device's own /api/system/info response.

devices.description:
Devices are the non-miner power consumers (fan, router...), declared by
hand since nothing can poll them -- so the installation's figures
they feed are only ever an informative estimate, kept apart from the
miners' measured ones.

ratePerKwh.description: RatePerKwh is the electricity cost in euros per kilowatt-hour (e.g. 0.1915 for 19.15 cts/kWh).

dashboardURL.description:
DashboardURL is the dashboard's own address as reached from where the
messages are read (e.g. http://192.168.1.60) -- for their links.

language.description: Language is the messages' language: "fr" or "en" (the default).

dashboards.description:
Dashboards maps a stratum pool hostname to its web dashboard URL
template. Use {user} as placeholder — replaced by the account part
of the stratum user (before the first dot). Example:
"stratum.braiins.com" -> "https://pool.braiins.com/mining/overview/{user}"

power.description: Power is the device's constant draw, in watts.

sendUser.description:
SendUser, SendPools and SendIP opt in to pushing the stratum users (a
wallet address, often), the pools and the miners' IPs (a map of the
local network) -- off by default, nothing sensitive leaves the Pi
unless the operator asks for it. Without SendIP a board knows each
miner by an IPv6 made from its MAC instead (see the feeder's
maskedIP).

x-enum-comments.ReportEvery2Days: every other night: the 2 days before
x-enum-comments.ReportMonthly: the night of the 1st: the month before
x-enum-comments.ReportWeekly: Sunday to Monday night: Monday to Sunday

x-enum-descriptions: every other night: the 2 days before
Sunday to Monday night: Monday to Sunday
the night of the 1st: the month before

password.description:
Password is write-only through the API: it's stored here, but GET
/api/config/settings only ever says whether one is set (see
handler.appSettingsResponse).

firmwareCache.description:
FirmwareCache is the feeder's check for new firmware releases, once
per its TTL.

remotePushConfigured.description:
RemotePushConfigured is whether settings.yml has a hashboard push URL
and key -- the UI only asks for the board's info (GET
/api/remote/board) when it has.

auditReport.description:
AuditReport is the feeder's record of the daily audit mail (see
auditreport.State), read back from disk -- the feeder sends it.

firmwareCacheCheckedAt.description:
FirmwareCacheCheckedAt is the most recent CheckedAt across every
model in the firmware cache (RFC3339, UTC) -- omitted if the cache
is empty (nothing checked yet, e.g. fresh install or no miner has
triggered a check). Lets the UI show "was this actually run" rather
than just the configured TTL.

notifications.description:
Notifications shadows the embedded AppSettingsFile.Notifications: same
JSON key, but a shape with no SMTP password field at all -- it never
leaves the server.

skipIfEmpty.description: SkipIfEmpty sends nothing for a period nothing was recorded in.

types.description: Types is never null, unlike the config's (empty = every type).

lastFrom.description:
LastFrom/LastTo is the period last mailed ("2006-01-02", To
excluded).

passwordSet.description: PasswordSet is all that's ever said about the password.

lastCheckAt.description:
LastCheckAt is the last time the mailer looked for a mail to send --
once a minute, so an old one means its loop is stuck.

lang.description: Lang picks the mail's language, the dashboard's own ("fr" or "en").

appVersion.description:
AppVersion is the semver this binary was published under (e.g.
"0.1.0"), only set on a tagged-release build -- "dev" (the zero
value's meaning) everywhere else, including the rolling "latest"
build. The UI shows this instead of BuildSHA when it's a real
version, and falls back to BuildSHA otherwise -- see
internal/version.Version.

appVersionStatus.description:
Whether this dashboard-api/remote-dashboard-api build itself is up to
date with GitHub's "latest" release ("unknown" | "upToDate" |
"updateAvailable") — see internal/appversion. Checked server-side at
most once a day, so every client reads the same cached answer.

buildSHA.description: Git commit this binary was built from

hashboardURL.description:
HashboardURL is the base URL of the hashboard instance backing this
remote-dashboard-api (remote-dashboard-api only, config.HashboardURL)
— lets the UI build a link to the board owner's hashboard account page.

remote.description:
Remote is true for remote-dashboard-api, false for dashboard-api --
the single React codebase can't otherwise tell which binary it's
talking to (both serve the same routes, and hashboardURL alone isn't
a reliable signal: remote-dashboard-api can leave it unconfigured
too, see resources/remote-dashboard.yml). The UI needs this to know
whether an unrecognized single path segment is even worth treating
as a possible board id in the first place -- on dashboard-api, no
board ever exists, so a mistyped URL must never surface board-only
chrome (the public/private chip, the "board is private" screen).

ui.description:
UI mirrors config.UIConfig (each value normalized, so the frontend
never sees an empty string) -- the single React codebase shows
everything unless a flag here says otherwise, instead of hardcoding
what "local" vs "remote" means.

alias.description: Operator-set override for Hostname (see config.Bitaxe.DisplayName) -- empty when not set, UI falls back to Hostname

bestDiff.description: Highest difficulty value ever solved by the miner since start‑up

energyJPerTh.description: Energy consumption per terahash (Joules per TH)

error.description:
Error surfaces a serious inconsistency the UI should call out
distinctly from a normal offline/unreachable state -- currently just
a mismatch between the configured mac: and what the device itself
reports (wrong device at this IP, or a config typo).

fallbackStratumDashboardURL.description: Web dashboard URL for the fallback pool

fanspeed.description: Fan speed (linked to the Temp field)

hashRateTHs.description: Additional fields requested by the API

ip.description: Miner IP address (derived from the folder name)

latestVersion.description: Latest firmware version available on GitHub

networkDifficulty.description: Current network difficulty reported by the pool (unitless)

releaseURL.description: GitHub releases page for the latest firmware version

stratumDashboardURL.description: Web dashboard URL for the primary pool

stratumPort.description: Port of the primary Stratum pool

stratumURL.description:
Pool urls -- Stratum(Port|Fallback...) is what the device itself is
currently connected with, straight off its own /api/system/info
(see handler.PayloadStructure) -- not to be confused with the
*configured* pool (config.Bitaxe.Url/Port/...), which the UI reads
separately from GET /api/config/miners and compares against these to
flag drift (see ui/src/utils/poolDrift.ts).

stratumUser.description: Username (typically miner ID) for the primary pool

totalElectricityCost.description:
TotalElectricityCost is this miner's cumulative cost (in the
operator's own currency, see settings.yml's electricity.ratePerKwh)
since it has been tracked -- each poll's slice uses the rate that was
actually in effect at that poll (RawSample.ElectricityRate), not
today's rate, so a later rate change never rewrites past cost. Not
shown per-miner in the UI -- summed across the fleet for the
"Électricité" KPI card's all-time figure instead.

totalUptimeSeconds.description:
Total* are persistent, reboot-surviving counters (see
internal/storage.Totals) -- unlike SharesAccepted/SharesRejected and
UptimeSeconds above, which reset whenever the device itself reboots,
these keep accumulating for as long as the miner has been tracked.
Zero until the feeder has written at least one totals.json for this
miner, or until the backfill tool has run.

boardPublic.description:
BoardPublic reflects hashboard's Account.Public flag for this board
(remote-dashboard-api only) — meaningless/always false for local
dashboard-api, which has no such concept and whose UI never reads it.

devices.description:
Echoed from settings so the dashboard needs no second request. Nothing
about them is tracked over time: a constant declared draw can't give a
real cumulative cost, only an informative estimate.

minerRestart.description:
MinerRestart/MinerPoolSwitch: "enabled" | "readonly" | "hidden" --
see config.UIActionConfig. "readonly" renders the button disabled
(with a hint), "hidden" doesn't render it at all.
